model.checkpoint_selection: minimum development recursive MSE with per-horizon/channel training hold-error normalization; same model architecture at every checkpoint including initialization

data.split: ceil(1/4 of recording IDs), minimum1 and at least1remaining, ordered by SHA256 of recording ID; no outcome-based selection
data.sampling: balance across recording identities; deterministic SHA256 priority of recording/segment/source origin within each recording
data.update: fixed recipe refit from retained training-window cache plus fresh recordings; freeze original development observations and roles; cache stays384windows; reject reused recording IDs or exact content; preserve old revision

evaluation.outer_roles: existing evaluation recordings excluded from fit/update, but previously inspected
evaluation.fresh_update: reserve one calibration recording by sorted identity for update when at least3 calibration recordings exist; initial fit uses the others, original automatic development split stays pinned through update
references: the same model initialization before neural fitting
limits: No untouched new recording or platform holdout claim.
Euclidean observation model does not enforce rotation geometry or infer sensor availability.
No controller behavior changes or calibrated uncertainty claims.
This is a candidate frozen default, not a validated replacement for the stable structured fit.
